Definition: feminine of a derivative of G4404 as noun; day-dawn:--early, morning.
BiblicalUsage: Proia is the morning itself, the day-dawn. Matthew says when the morning was come, the chief priests took counsel against Jesus, and John says when the morning was now come, Jesus stood on the shore.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that morning brings both counsel against him and his appearing to his friends, and the same dawn judges one and comforts the other.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
